description: PHP MVC framework (PHP 8.3+, MySQL, Pug views, Vue 3) made for coding agents: write each feature once as a capability (a Caligrafy\Service with #[Capability]) and serve it to web pages, forms, a REST API, a JS client, AI agents over MCP and Snap Cards. Declarative routes (Route::page, form, auth, action), a query builder, migrations, queues, Stripe, OpenAI and a Claude Code plugin. Describe it. Approve it. Ship it.
rules: Write each feature once as a capability: a class extending Caligrafy\Service in application/services/ with a #[Capability(name:, description:, scope:)] attribute, every input declared in $rules, data returned from handle(array $input, Context $context), and refusals thrown as ServiceError.

Only capabilities touch models. Declare every request in application/config/routing/web.php with Route::page (data from capabilities), Route::form, Route::auth, Route::webhook, Route::download, Route::capability or Route::capabilities (REST), Route::mcp (agents), Route::snap (cards) or Route::action on a webOnly: true capability. Do not write new controllers.
Never render, redirect, print or read the session inside a capability. Only a webOnly: true capability reached through Route::action may read the session or sign people in.

Read data with the query builder (Book::where('author_id', $id)->with('author')->paginate(20), Database::table()) or bound ? placeholders. Never concatenate request data into SQL, and load related rows with with() instead of a query per row.
Change a table that already holds data with a migration (php caligrafer.php migrate make <name>, then php caligrafer.php migrate). Never edit a migration that already ran.

Pug views compile to PHP: join strings with '.', never '+'. Every form carries =csrf(), and JSON calls from a page send Accept: application/json with the X-CSRF-Token header (apiHeaders() or the generated JS client).
Never put API keys or personal access tokens in pages, VITE_ variables or bundles. Browser clients use the session; programs and agents use tokens made with php caligrafer.php token create.

New pages extend ../default/master/site and use the page components of public/css/layout.css (cq-hero, cq-band, cq-field, cq-rows, cq-tiles). Change the look with a design style (DESIGN_STYLE in .env), never by editing tokens.css or the views.
Run php -l on changed PHP files, php caligrafer.php test for the app's tests and php caligrafer.php doctor to check the project. Leave framework/ unchanged in an application.
